title: security: RBAC v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging for cross-account keys
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: customers with strict data residency and multi-account KMS setups required stronger server-side enforcement and observability when keys are region-restricted or cross-account. This PR extends RBAC v2 to enforce KMS region pinning, surface mismatches in policy evaluation, and wire up audit logging for any KMS operations that cross residency boundaries. The change includes policy schema additions, enforcement hooks in the auth pipeline, KMS resolver updates to validate regional residency for imported keys, and richer audit events to aid compliance reviews. Checklist: - [x] add RBAC v2 policy fields for kms.region and kms.allow_cross_account - [x] validation + migration for existing policies - [x] enforcement in token evaluation path with clear error codes - [x] KMS resolver: detect cross-account keys and attach residency metadata - [x] audit logging: emit structured events for rejected/allowed KMS operations with reason and effective policy id - [x] unit and integration tests + local end-to-end runbook - [x] docs/console UI hints for admins Migration notes: existing policies without kms.region default to permissive to avoid breakage; we add a server-side migration that annotates policies derived from UI templates and flags them for review. Rollout plan: feature-gate behind release flag 'rbac_v2_kms_hardening'; staged canary to Dedicated customers first, then global rollout after 72h monitoring window. Impact: tightens enforcement for orgs using region-pin constraints and improves auditability for SOC/Privacy requests. If false positives are seen, ops can toggle the release flag and opt-in affected orgs for a corrective migration.
commits: feat(rbac): add kms.region and kms.allow_cross_account fields to policy schema
fix(kms-resolver): surface residency metadata for imported cross-account keys
feat(auth): enforce kms region pinning in token evaluation path (return 403 with RBAC_ERROR_CODE_KMS_REGION_MISMATCH)
chore(migration): add server-side migration to annotate legacy policies
test: add unit + integration tests for policy evaluation and audit events
docs: admin console hints and runbook for KMS region pinning
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Please add a clear error code for the 403 response so clients can programmatically detect region pin failures.
Ava Chen (author): Added RBAC_ERROR_CODE_KMS_REGION_MISMATCH and updated evaluator.go to return structured error with code and policy_id.
Priya Nair: Audit events need to include the effective policy id and the detected key region; otherwise compliance can't map events to rules.
Ava Chen (author): Included policy_id and key_region in the audit payload, updated audit schema and tests.
Liam O'Connor: Migration SQL looks fine but please add a retry-safe predicate for idempotency during canary rollouts.
Ava Chen (author): Made migration idempotent and added a dry-run flag; updated runbook.
Security CI: vulnerability scan flagged a third-party YAML parser; pinned version and re-ran checks.
QA: ran Dedicated canary against a staging org with cross-account keys; observed one false positive due to missing metadata, fixed resolver edge case.
ci_details: CI pipeline: lint -> unit -> integration -> e2e (staging) -> security-scan
Initial run: unit tests failed (policy migration edgecase) - fixed in commit 3
Security scan: dependency pin required (yaml parser) - updated go.mod
Final run: all stages passed; e2e flake retried once and passed
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and emit detailed audit logs for KMS operations. Administrators can opt-out via feature flag during rollout. See docs/admin/kms-region-pinning.md for migration steps.
